verdicts.reason: A shrinks the coffee bag photo to a small thumbnail and blows the Q logo up to the same size beside it, so the logo competes with the product. The SAVE badge is oversized, and the CTA is small and jammed against the bottom edge, so the hierarchy is broken. B keeps the bag as a large hero image and the logo at a sensible size, but it has clear flaws: the logo and SAVE badge are crowded together at the top, the CTA is indented and does not line up with the left text edge, and the image panel starts with an awkward dark strip on its left while bleeding off the right and bottom edges.
